INSERT INTO channel_listings (platform_id, product_id, external_item_id, external_sku)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
        ON CONFLICT (platform_id, external_item_id) DO UPDATE SET
            product_id   = EXCLUDED.product_id,
            external_sku = EXCLUDED.external_sku,
            updated_at   = now()
        RETURNING id
